# MWEF v0.3.0-pre.1

This pre-release introduces the built-in MWEF online package manager.

## Changes

- Added `mwef-lib-packmanager`, a built-in Xiaomi WebUI-style plugin catalog and package manager.
- Added online install, update, reinstall, enable, disable, removal, and permission confirmation workflows.
- Added a popup software-source editor for the official GitHub index, automatic jsDelivr fallback, custom catalog URLs, and optional GitHub download proxies.
- Added verified package downloads with HTTPS-only redirects, exact size and SHA-256 checks, strict catalog validation, and fail-closed MWEF compatibility checks.
- Added clean atomic staging, recovery copies, serialized framework/plugin transactions, and rollback on repatch failures.
- Hardened plugin archives against reserved state injection, special files, oversized expansion, excessive entries, core file replacement, and LuCI path conflicts.
- Added bilingual English and Simplified Chinese UI, documentation, and validation coverage.

## Safety

MWEF still performs no MTD write, partition flash, block-device write, Bootloader change, or writable SquashFS remount. Framework and plugin packages are staged under `/data/other_vol`; installed versions are preserved before activation and restored when activation fails.

## Test target

- Xiaomi Router BE6500 Pro
- Hardware code RD08
- Target `ipq53xx/generic`
